rules.statement: DIRECT_OUT provides full write and read access to all 32 bits of the DATA_OUT register.

rules.condition: a write to MASKED_OUT_UPPER or MASKED_OUT_LOWER
rules.statement: Upper 16 bits of the write are a mask of bits to modify and lower 16 bits are data; hardware updates only masked DATA_OUT bits without read-modify-write.

rules.condition: a read of a masked output register
rules.statement: Reads return the upper or lower 16 bits of DATA_OUT in the lower 16 bits, with zeros in the upper 16 mask-field bits.

rules.condition: software needs to read the value on the pins
rules.statement: Software should read the DATA_IN register to read what is on the pins.
DATA_OE is accessible directly via DIRECT_OE and with masked access via MASKED_OE_UPPER and MASKED_OE_LOWER, with the same semantics as DATA_OUT.
The output enable is sent to the pad control block to determine whether the pad drives the DATA_OUT value to the pin.

rules.condition: GPIO output is unused (not wired to a pin or not selected for pin multiplexing)
rules.statement: Output values of unused GPIOs are disconnected and have no effect on the GPIO input regardless of output enable values.
The per-pin and 32-bit register views alias the same state, and a write to a per-pin register affects only its own GPIO.

Per-pin view has separate aligned ranges: PER_PIN_IO holds one register per GPIO for DATA_OUT/DATA_IN bit i; configuration range holds consecutive PER_PIN_OE_n and PER_PIN_INTR_CTRL_n registers per GPIO.
A register write must cover all bytes of the register that hold a field.
Output enable and interrupt configuration of a GPIO are in separate registers so access to one can be granted without the other.
INTR_STATE, INTR_ENABLE and INTR_TEST have no per-pin view.
DATA_IN is always readable and reflects the value at the chip input pad regardless of DATA_OE.
Each of the 32 inputs can be independently enabled for the 16-cycle noise filter via CTRL_EN_INPUT_FILTER, applied to both DATA_IN and interrupt detection.

rules.condition: pin-multiplexing unit present and the peripheral input is not connected to a chip input
rules.statement: GPIO peripheral inputs not connected to a chip input are tied to constant zero.

rules.condition: after reset, first cycle strap_en_i is asserted
rules.statement: GPIO detects strap_en_i low-to-high and one clock cycle later samples the GPIO inputs into HW_STRAPS_DATA_IN.

rules.condition: after the strap sample is taken
rules.statement: All 32 input bits are sampled regardless of output enable, and later input changes are not captured in HW_STRAPS_DATA_IN.
The GPIO provides 32 interrupt signals, each independently enabled, tested and configured.

rules.condition: interrupt enabled via INTR_ENABLE and INTR_CTRL_EN registers
rules.statement: Interrupt state is readable in INTR_STATE only when enabled, and can be triggered only by GPIO input.
Writing 1 to an INTR_STATE bit clears that interrupt.
Each bit supports rising-edge, falling-edge, level-high and level-low interrupt detection, selected by the corresponding INTR_CTRL_EN register.
An input may be configured for both rising and falling edge detection, with no hardware indication of which edge caused the interrupt.
All inputs pass through the optional noise filter before interrupt detection.
Interrupts to the processor are level interrupts; edge detection is converted into a level interrupt.
